name: In-LineLinc 0-10V Ballast Dimmer
description: The In-LineLinc 0-10V ballast dimmer, which runs the KeypadLinc code base and works as a 0-10V dimmer or two relays. Its two input lines trigger groups 1 through 4, which use the on masks, on-levels and ramp rates of groups 2 through 5.

enumerations.name: manualChangeDirection
enumerations.description: Which way a manual change moves the level.

operatingFlags.name: programmingLock
operatingFlags.description: Linking and programming from the device itself are locked out.

operatingFlags.name: ledOnTransmit
operatingFlags.description: The status LED blinks when the device sends an Insteon message.

operatingFlags.name: ledOff
operatingFlags.description: The status LEDs and button backlights are off.

verification.note: Insteon's earliest command sheet swaps 0x08 and 0x09 (backlight on and off); the later sheets, used here, agree with the Insteon for Hub app. The Insteon Developer's Guide reads bit 4 of the 0x00 reply as LED on, but the later command sheets read it as LED off, the state 0x08 sets.

operatingFlags.name: keyBeep
operatingFlags.description: The device beeps when a button is pressed.

operatingFlags.name: radioOff
operatingFlags.description: The device doesn't originate RF messages. It still repeats the RF messages it hears.

operatingFlags.name: powerLineOff
operatingFlags.description: Insteon communication over the powerline is off. The device turns it back on whenever it powers up.

operatingFlags.name: applicationRetries
operatingFlags.description: The device retries application messages as many times as its ALL-Link database says, and reports cleanup errors.

operatingFlags.name: x10Off
operatingFlags.description: X10 sending and receiving are off.

operatingFlags.name: cleanupReport
operatingFlags.description: The device sends a success report after the cleanup messages that follow a group command.

operatingFlags.name: smartHops
operatingFlags.description: Each message starts with the hop count of the last acknowledgment received (smart hops). When the bit is 0, each message starts with one hop.

operatingFlags.name: relayMode
operatingFlags.description: The dimmer works as a relay rather than a 0-10V dimmer.

readings.name: databaseDelta
readings.description: A count that goes up whenever the ALL-Link database changes.

readings.name: crcErrorCount
readings.description: The number of messages received with a CRC error.

verification.note: The Insteon Developer's Guide gives query 0x02 as a signal-to-noise value; the later command sheets count messages with CRC errors there.

values.name: inputEnabled
values.description: Whether group D1, one of the groups 2 through 5 that the input lines use, is enabled: 0x01 when it is and 0x00 when it isn't. The In-Line 0-10VDC Dimmer Developer Notes call it the on mask.

values.name: x10HouseCode
values.description: The X10 house code, or 0x20 for no X10 address.

values.name: rampRate
values.description: The ramp rate, from 0x01 (8 minutes) to 0x1F (0.1 second). 0x00 is 2 seconds.

values.name: onLevel
values.description: The level the load turns on to, from 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full).

values.name: ledBrightness
values.description: The brightness of the status LEDs, from 0x11 (dimmest) to 0x7F (brightest).

writes.name: inputEnabled
writes.description: Enables (0x01) or disables (0x00) group D1, one of the groups 2 through 5 that the input lines use.

writes.name: rampRate
writes.description: Sets the ramp rate of group D1.

writes.name: onLevel
writes.description: Sets the on-level of group D1.

writes.name: ledBrightness
writes.description: Sets the brightness of the status LED.

writes.name: dacRange
writes.description: Sets the range of the 0-10V output: D3 points to the start of the DAC table (the minimum) and D4 to its end (the maximum).

writes.name: maxRetries
writes.description: Sets how many times the device retries a message, from 0x01 to 0xFF. 0x00 restores the factory default of 5.

parameter.name: onLevel
parameter.description: In dimmer mode, the level to go to at the saved ramp rate, from 0x00 to 0xFF. In relay mode, bit 0 turns relay 1 on and bit 1 relay 2.

standardCommands.name: lightOnFast
standardCommands.description: Turns the load full on instantly. The In-Line 0-10VDC Dimmer Developer Notes give cmd2 as the on-level.

parameter.name: onLevel
parameter.description: The level to go to, from 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full).

standardCommands.name: lightOff
standardCommands.description: Turns the load off, at the saved ramp rate in dimmer mode.

parameter.name: relays
parameter.description: In relay mode, bit 0 turns relay 1 off and bit 1 relay 2. The dimmer ignores it.

standardCommands.name: lightOffFast
standardCommands.description: Turns the load off instantly. The device ignores cmd2.

standardCommands.name: brightenOneStep
standardCommands.description: Brightens the load one step of 16 from off to full. The device ignores cmd2.

standardCommands.name: dimOneStep
standardCommands.description: Dims the load one step of 16 from off to full. The device ignores cmd2.

standardCommands.name: startManualChange
standardCommands.description: Starts brightening or dimming the load until a stop manual change command.

parameter.name: direction
parameter.description: Which way to change the level.

standardCommands.name: stopManualChange
standardCommands.description: Stops a manual change. The device ignores cmd2.

standardCommands.name: readStatus
standardCommands.description: Reads the load's level. The acknowledgment's cmd1 carries the ALL-Link database delta.

standardCommands.name: beep
standardCommands.description: Beeps once, as pressing the SET button does. The device ignores cmd2.

extendedCommands.name: readLimits
extendedCommands.description: Reads the retry count and the 0-10V output's range with a second extended Get, which has 0x04 in D3.

values.name: maxRetries
values.description: How many times the device retries a message.

values.name: dacMinimum
values.description: The start of the DAC table: the output's minimum.

values.name: dacMaximum
values.description: The end of the DAC table: the output's maximum.

notes: Insteon's earlier command sheets give ramp rates 0x00 through 0x1F as 9 minutes down to 0.1 second; the later ones make 0x01 8 minutes and 0x00 2 seconds.
Insteon's earlier command sheet describes selector 0x02 as a mask whose bits 0 and 1 disable relays 1 and 2.

The In-Line 0-10VDC Dimmer Developer Notes mark bit 2 of the 0x00 reply and bits 2 and 4 of the 0x05 reply N/A and lists no Set Operating Flags for resume dim, error blink or the checksum flag, so they're left out here; the command workbook gives them for the KeypadLinc code base.
The In-Line 0-10VDC Dimmer Developer Notes send Set Operating Flags as an extended message with a checksum in D14.
The In-Line 0-10VDC Dimmer Developer Notes list the input groups in D1 of the DAC range and retry Sets as well, but doesn't say whether the device keeps them per group.
The second Get's reply has the same cmd2 and D2 as the first's, so a reply is told apart only by the request it answers.
The In-Line 0-10VDC Dimmer Developer Notes list no status request; Insteon's 2007 command tables give cmd1 0x19 for every dimmer.
